resources.string: See the real autofill / keyboard / accessibility holders
A read-only look at who actually holds the autofill slot, which keyboard is active, and which accessibility services are live. Nothing here changes any setting.
%1$d third-party accessibility service(s) can read on-screen text and inject taps — the real scrape risk.
Read-only. This screen reads settings; it never changes them.
Autofill: passgen is the active provider.
Autofill: another provider holds the slot (likely your password manager). Without elevation, Android only tells passgen "us or not us" — not who the other provider is.
Keyboard: the passgen keyboard is enabled.
Keyboard: the passgen keyboard is not enabled; another keyboard is active.
Grant Shizuku below to see the actual named holders and which accessibility services are live.
Name the actual autofill provider (not just "us / not us")
List live accessibility services and flag third-party scrape risks
Open Accessibility settings to review which services can read your screen.
